chapter: Building McShann's big band and blues records
title: Assembling the big band
summary: Ramey and McShann went to Omaha to fetch Bob Merrill; others came from Towles and Ernie Fields.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Well, I mean, this band that you put together, I mean, they were all Kansas City guys fellows for the most part, were they? Or people in Kansas City?

Yeah -- no, not necessarily. Remember, I went with McShann to Omaha to get Bob Merle. And Bob was with some band up there. I think Bob wanted a lot of money, and McShann had to hail him out. But then he got a trombone player out of Mat Towles band, and he got this guy Lester out of Ernie Fields' band. And the rest of us were local

talent.
But the band began to hit pretty good. Scotty was doing the arranging: not much, but we used those same things we had with the seven pieces, and just voiced them out for the other horns, you know, fixed little riffs and things.
